frozen_claim: Реальные нейронные последовательности (HVC-пение, гиппокампальный replay, кортикальные preparatory-последовательности) генерируются ДЕТЕРМИНИРОВАННОЙ хаотической итинерацией SCO-типа — траектория живёт на strange-аттракторе с малым положительным старшим показателем Ляпунова — а НЕ шум-индуцированными переходами между устойчивыми метастабильными состояниями; поэтому ПОРЯДОК переходов почти детерминирован (задан графом), тогда как ВРЕМЕНА переходов чувствительно зависят от начальных условий.

observable.name: stable_chain_sufficiency_and_lyapunov_bound_on_hvc_timing
observable.definition: On synthetic models calibrated to zebra-finch HVC literature (order stereotypy >99%, duration CV 5-15%, sub-ms spike-timing precision over a ~1 s song), test whether deterministic chaotic itinerancy (lambda_1>0) is NECESSARY as the source of timing variability, via four probes: (A) a stable K-link adaptation-clocked chain with Gaussian timing noise -- does it reproduce rigid order (0 errors) AND low duration CV (5-15%)? (B) a 1-D continuous-noise timing-variance budget V(T)=D(e^{2 lambda T}-1)/(2 lambda), calibrated so lambda=0 gives the observed 1 ms end-of-song jitter -- how large does end-point jitter grow as lambda rises, versus the sub-ms observation? (C, DECISIVE) the saddle-exit normal form tau=(1/lambda) ln(a/x0), x0=eps|z| -- is Var(tau)=Var(ln|z|)/lambda^2 independent of the noise scale, and does timing dispersion vanish as eps->0 at any lambda? (D) the mean/CV lambda-lock lambda=std(ln|z|)/(CV*mean) -- does a realistic (mean,CV) force a lambda whose amplification destroys sub-ms precision? The strong thesis is FALSIFIED if (a) the timing precision implies lambda_1<=0 on the flagship example AND (b) the stable noise+adaptation model matches the order and CV statistics at least as well.
observable.source_ref: arXiv:2606.00373 (Zang & Curto, Sequential chaotic oscillations in excitatory-inhibitory threshold-linear networks) -- seed paper that proves SCO EXIST in abstract E-I TLNs and that a graph predicts transition order; the duel tests a SEPARATE strong hypothesis (chaos as the SOURCE of timing variability in REAL neural sequences) on synthetic HVC-calibrated toys, not the paper's existence theorem.

model.generative: Four synthetic/analytic toys (numpy): (A) stable adaptation chain, interval = tau + sigma*N(0,1), K=5 links, tau=150 ms, sigma=12 ms, 8000 trials; (B) timing-variance budget V(T)=D(e^{2 lambda T}-1)/(2 lambda) with D=1e-6 s^2/s so sqrt(D*T)=1 ms at T=1 s, lambda=0; (C) saddle-exit normal form tau=(1/lambda) ln(a/x0), x0=eps|z|, z~N(0,1), 5e6 draws for Var(ln|z|); (D) lambda-lock lambda=std(ln|z|)/(CV*mean).
model.config: chain K=5 tau=0.15 s sigma=0.012 s N=8000 seed=0; poisson-escape rate=1/0.15 n=4e5 seed=11; jitter T in {1.0,0.05} s lambda in {0,0.5,1,2,5,10}/s D=1e-6; saddle-exit z~N(0,1) 5e6 draws seed=7, eps sweep {1e-2,1e-4,1e-8,0} at lambda=5/s a=0.1; lambda-lock (mean_ms,CV) in {(50,0.15),(150,0.15),(50,0.10)}.
model.controls: Poisson-escape arm included to show the CV~1 discriminator targets a straw man, not the adaptation-clock account; eps=0 arm shows the saddle-exit dispersion vanishes with no initial-condition noise at any lambda, isolating noise (not chaos) as the source.

thresholds.decision_rule: The STRONG thesis is FALSIFIED (CON) if (A) the stable chain reaches duration CV within [0.05,0.15] at 0 order errors (phenomenology reproduced without chaos) AND (B/C/D) reproducing the observed timing requires either a lambda whose end-of-song jitter far exceeds the sub-ms observation, or a saddle-exit dispersion that is shown to be noise-scale-set (Var(tau)=Var(ln|z|)/lambda^2, vanishing as eps->0), or a mean/CV lambda-lock forcing an amplification that destroys sub-ms precision. The thesis would SURVIVE only if the stable chain failed to match the statistics AND a positive lambda were required to reach sub-ms jitter.

nulls: saddle_exit_eps_to_zero: with no initial-condition noise the saddle-exit dispersion must vanish at ANY lambda; it does (std->0), so chaos is not the source of the variability -- noise is.
jitter_lambda_zero_baseline: at lambda=0 the calibrated end-of-song jitter is exactly the observed 1 ms, so any excess at lambda>0 is pure amplification.
failure_modes: All models are synthetic/analytic toys calibrated to textbook HVC values; no neural data are touched, so the decisive observable is a proxy, not paper-faithful (the central limitation).
The lambda-budget V(T) is a 1-D linear-noise model of timing dispersion, not a full E-I threshold-linear network simulation.

The saddle-exit variance identity Var(tau)=Var(ln|z|)/lambda^2 holds for the 1-D normal-form exit and may not transfer to a multi-dimensional strange attractor with structured initial-condition geometry.
Only the songbird flagship is addressed; hippocampal replay and cortical preparatory sequences are untested.
Direct local-Lyapunov estimates from neural trajectories remain absent, so the real-data sign of lambda_1 is not measured.
accepted_evidence_criteria: Falsification of the strong thesis is accepted if the stable adaptation chain reaches duration CV in [0.05,0.15] at 0 order errors (phenomenology reproduced without a positive exponent) AND the timing-precision arms show a positive lambda either smears end-of-song jitter far beyond the sub-ms observation, or that the saddle-exit dispersion is noise-scale-set and vanishes as eps->0, or that the mean/CV lambda-lock forces a precision-destroying amplification.
rejected_evidence_criteria: The Poisson-escape CV~1 result is not admitted as a discriminator (it refutes a straw man). No real-neural-data claim about the local Lyapunov sign is admitted from these synthetic/analytic toys regardless of outcome; the seed paper's existence theorem for SCO is not adjudicated.
